FOLIO / A QUICK START

Screens to showreel.

  1. Add up to 12 images. Any image size is accepted and fitted into 1920 × 1080 without cropping or stretching. Uploads sort naturally by filename, so Screen 2 comes before Screen 10. Drag the screens to change the order, or use Sort by name to restore filename order.
  2. Set your pace. Change time per screen or total duration. Choose Soft or Stiff and adjust the transition length.
  3. Choose your format. Export a 30 fps video or a looping, full-resolution GIF with transitions sampled at 20 fps. GIF uses up to 256 colors per frame.

Video renders in real time; keep this tab visible. GIF renders frame by frame and may take longer. Your uploads, settings, and output stay in your browser.
